# CounterPunch

> > Independent political journalism featuring critical analysis of U.S. foreign policy, war, and state power from a radical left perspective.

CounterPunch is a muckraking publication founded by Alexander Cockburn and Jeffrey St. Clair, offering investigative reporting and commentary on American militarism, Middle East conflicts, electoral politics, and social justice issues. The site features contributions from progressive writers including Tariq Ali, Howard Zinn, and Vijay Prashad.

## Key Topics

- U.S. Foreign Policy
- Afghanistan War
- Iraq Sanctions and Intervention
- Post-9/11 Politics
- Bush Administration
- Middle East Conflict
- Israeli-Palestinian Occupation
- NATO Military Intervention
- Vietnam War Legacy
- Electoral Politics (2000 Election)
- War on Terror
- Media Propaganda
- Direct Democracy
- Death Penalty Abolition

## War and U.S. Foreign Policy

- [Bush's Wars](https://www.counterpunch.org/2001/09/21/bush-s-wars-3): Cockburn & St. Clair analyze Bush's War on Terror and Afghanistan response
- [It's How We Fought the War](https://www.counterpunch.org/2001/05/03/it-s-how-we-fought-the-war): Bob Kerrey's Vietnam War crimes at Thanh Phong and Phoenix Program
- [The Pentagon's Blueprint](https://www.counterpunch.org/2001/09/29/the-pentagon-s-blueprint): Steve Perry examines Pentagon's fourth-generation warfare doctrine
- [War is only a secondary concern in a village that keeps being invaded](https://www.counterpunch.org/2001/10/13/war-is-only-a-secondary-concern-in-a-village-that-keeps-being-invaded): Patrick Cockburn reports on drought and Taliban conflict on Shomali plain
- [New Labor, New Bombs](https://www.counterpunch.org/2001/02/27/new-labor-new-bombs): Tariq Ali critiques Tony Blair's Iraq bombing and New Labour policy
- [Genocide Scholar "Silenced" on Academic List For Comments About Bombing of Afghanistan](https://www.counterpunch.org/2001/10/26/genocide-scholar-silenced-on-academic-list-for-comments-about-bombing-of-afghanistan): Adam Jones censored on H-Genocide list for Afghanistan bombing criticism
- [Demonizing the Serbs](https://www.counterpunch.org/1999/06/15/demonizing-the-serbs): Marjaleena Repo examines media propaganda during NATO's Yugoslavia bombing
- [US shuts down Yugoslav Internet](https://www.counterpunch.org/1999/05/12/us-shuts-down-yugoslav-internet): US government shuts down Yugoslav internet via Loral Orion satellite

## Post-9/11 Analysis

- [An Architecture of Doom and Dread](https://www.counterpunch.org/2001/09/16/an-architecture-of-doom-and-dread): Jeffrey St. Clair critiques World Trade Center architecture post-9/11
- [Hitchens and American Innocence](https://www.counterpunch.org/2001/09/24/hitchens-and-american-innocence): Vijay Prashad challenges Hitchens on post-9/11 Afghanistan intervention
- [Bring Me the Head of Nostradamus](https://www.counterpunch.org/2001/09/24/bring-me-the-head-of-nostradamus): David Vest satirizes post-9/11 Nostradamus hoaxes and conspiracy theories

## Middle East and Palestine

- [Occupation and Resistance](https://www.counterpunch.org/2001/09/20/occupation-and-resistance): Carl Estabrook analyzes Israeli occupation and Palestinian resistance

## Electoral Politics and Democracy

- [Supreme Anxiety](https://www.counterpunch.org/2000/07/14/supreme-anxiety): Cockburn & St. Clair critique lesser-evil voting in 2000 election
- [Direct Democracy](https://www.counterpunch.org/2001/11/06/direct-democracy): Howard Zinn proposes constitutional amendment for direct democracy
- [Clinton Comes to Harlem](https://www.counterpunch.org/2001/02/15/clinton-comes-to-harlem): Clinton-Gore feud over Harlem office and 2000 election aftermath
- [25 Years After Vietnam: Beyond Left and Right](https://www.counterpunch.org/2000/04/14/25-years-after-vietnam-beyond-left-and-right): Cockburn & Raimondo discuss left-right antiwar coalition building

## Social Justice and Human Rights

- [Message Supporting a Global Moratoriumon the Death Penalty](https://www.counterpunch.org/1999/08/29/message-supporting-a-global-moratorium-on-the-death-penalty): Dalai Lama's message advocating global death penalty moratorium
- [Lawsuit Readied to Reverse Takeover By Pacifica Foundation Directors](https://www.counterpunch.org/1999/06/23/lawsuit-readied-to-reverse-takeover-by-pacifica-foundation-directors): Pacifica Foundation governance dispute over KPFK and KPFA control

## Investigative Reports

- [The Truth About The Bohemian Grove](https://www.counterpunch.org/2001/06/19/the-truth-about-the-bohemian-grove): Cockburn & St. Clair investigate elite Bohemian Grove gatherings

## Optional

- [On the Road With Cockburn And St. Clair](https://www.counterpunch.org/1998/06/15/on-the-road-with-cockburn-and-st-clair): Cockburn & St. Clair announce book tour for Al Gore critique
